scope: Select one frozen reference for the two complete V EEG interventions; not a success/SOTA declaration or final-test unlock
select_REF_PRIOR_V_only_if: Both complete paired manifests, saved images and all DINO/SEED evaluators pass their integrity checks
REF_PRIOR_V mean DINO2AFC is strictly higher than REF_REG
REF_PRIOR_V mean SEED is at least REF_REG
REF_PRIOR_V mean ObjectF1 is at least REF_REG
REF_PRIOR_V blank-proxy count is no greater than REF_REG
otherwise: Use REF_REG for full permuted/missing EEG controls; preserve and report any DINO-versus-semantics disagreement
ties: REF_REG, because it omits the sampled prior and has lower total inference cost
separate_practical_improvement_threshold: DINO2AFC >=+0.01 with semantics in the same direction; this is not required to index the strongest eligible internal reference and is not a SOTA definition
permuted_control: Existing frozen within-subject/R concept derangement; rerun the full encoder/prior chain using target query noise
missing_control: Existing all-zero63x250 EEG through the actual frozen encoder; out-of-distribution diagnostic
benchmark_scope_previously_reserved: Both references correct R4, selected-reference permuted/missing R4, selected-reference correct R1 and R80: at most12000 images
cross_R_limit: The already-frozen seed includes R and the backbone is trained on mean4; R1/R80 are separate cross-R generalization tracks, not a controlled same-noise repeat-count causal comparison or R-matched trained SOTA reproduction
